summary: Most frontend functionality for a unified app (global header + profile menu, in-app admin dashboard with 5 sections, admin route guarding, users list with approve/block/role toggle, and green-forward styling) appears implemented. However, there are key gaps/violations around first-user super_admin creation (blocked by Firestore rules), admin ability to modify super_admin approval in rules, the header not rendering on auth routes (REQ-3 AC), and the required logo asset file not evidenced in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: First-ever signup must create the first account with role="super_admin" and approved=true; all subsequent signups role="user" and approved=false.
missing_requirements.reason: Although client code assigns super_admin/approved for the first user, Firestore rules as shown deny creating any user document with role == "super_admin", which would prevent the first-user flow from working.

missing_requirements.requirement: Global header displayed on all pages/routes in the single app.
missing_requirements.reason: AppHeader is explicitly hidden on auth routes (/login, /signup, /reset), so not all routes/screens render the same header.

missing_requirements.requirement: Firestore rules must restrict modifications to existing super_admin users’ role/approval by non-super_admins.
missing_requirements.reason: Rules allow any admin (isAdmin()) to update any user's approved status without excluding super_admin targets, enabling an admin to change a super_admin's approval (contrary to AC).

missing_requirements.requirement: A logo file exists under frontend/public/assets/generated/ and is used in the header.
missing_requirements.reason: Header references /assets/generated/app-logo.dim_256x256.png, but the diff summary does not show the required image asset being added under frontend/public/assets/generated/.

hallucinated_features.description: Password reset flow implemented as UI-only with 'Admin-only manual reset' messaging and no Firebase password reset API call.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not request changing password reset behavior or adding admin-only manual reset messaging; it only specified auth via Firebase email/password and other admin/dashboard features.

hallucinated_features.description: Removed/changed Internet Identity integration in main.tsx.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints explicitly state not to modify immutable hook paths and `frontend/src/main.tsx`, but the diff summary indicates main.tsx was modified ("Internet Identity provider removed for UI-only phase").

hallucinated_features.description: Added extensive deployment and smoke-test documentation files.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask for new deployment runbooks or smoke test checklists; these are additional deliverables beyond requested app features.
